coverageRationale.zh: 把 GB/T 15852.1-2020 从“八种 MAC 的名称清单”推进到可复述的公式链：八步一般模型、CBC-MAC 递推、EMAC/retail/CMAC/LMAC 的末端变换、TrCBC/CBCR 的结构差异，以及 SM4 测试向量的核对路径。
coverageRationale.en: Moves GB/T 15852.1-2020 from a name list of eight MACs to a reproducible formula chain: the eight-step model, CBC-MAC recurrence, EMAC/retail/CMAC/LMAC final transforms, the structural differences of TrCBC/CBCR, and the SM4 test-vector verification path.

title.zh: 消息鉴别码 第1部分：采用分组密码的机制
title.en: Message Authentication Codes—Part 1: Mechanisms Using a Block Cipher

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh: MAC：用共享密钥为消息生成标签，验证完整性与来源。
CBC-MAC：把消息块逐块异或后送分组密码，取最后状态。
CMAC：用 K1/K2 区分整块与非整块，适合任意长度消息。
截断：只输出标签左侧 m 位，缩短传输但不增加安全。
en: MAC: a shared-key tag over a message, checked for integrity and origin.
CBC-MAC: XOR each message block into a CBC chain and take the final state.
CMAC: uses K1/K2 for complete and incomplete blocks, suitable for arbitrary lengths.
Truncation: output only the leftmost m bits; it saves bandwidth but adds no security.

zh.principle: **标准**：GB/T 15852.1-2020 消息鉴别码 第1部分：采用分组密码的机制（Message Authentication Codes—Part 1: Mechanisms Using a Block Cipher）。GB/T 15852.1-2020 把采用分组密码的 MAC 写成一条八步流水线：密钥诱导（可选）、消息填充、数据分割、初始变换、迭代应用分组密码、最终迭代、输出变换、截断。最基础的 CBC-MAC 令 H0=0^n，逐块计算 Hi=E_K(Pi⊕Hi-1)，最后输出 Hm；其余七种算法都是在这条链的起点、终点或截断规则上做变换，以适配任意长度消息或降低密钥与存储开销。
zh.why: CBC-MAC 只对固定长度消息可靠；把任意长度消息直接送进去，攻击者可用长度扩展拼出合法新消息。EMAC 在末端加一次独立密钥加密，ANSI retail MAC 用双密钥的加密-解密变换，CMAC 用 K1/K2 区分整块与非整块，都是在不增加过多分组调用的情况下切断这种拼接。标准把八种算法放在同一模型下，是为了让实现者按消息长度、密钥长度、存储和调用次数选型，同时用统一测试向量核对填充、初始变换、最终迭代和截断是否一致。
zh.used: 选型时先看消息空间：固定长度可用 CBC-MAC；任意长度优先 CMAC、EMAC 或 TrCBC；密钥长度只有分组密钥两倍时可用 MacDES；存储受限可看 TrCBC/CBCR。实现按附录 B 的测试向量逐步核对：SM4 分组长度 128 位、密钥 128 位；CMAC 子密钥 K1=dbl(E_K(0^n))、K2=dbl(K1)；截断只取规定位，不能自行改成异或或哈希。
zh.broken: MAC 只给完整性和来源鉴别，不给保密性；密钥跨协议、跨方向复用会削弱安全边界。截断到 m 位后，理想伪造概率约为 2^-m，但 m 太短时生日界和在线查询会让它更快被击穿。验证必须常量时间比较，不能按字节短路；CBC-MAC 不能直接用于变长消息；TrCBC 的标签长度受 n/2 限制，不能把它当通用长标签 MAC。
zh.history:
GB/T 15852.1-2020 于 2020-12-14 发布、2021-07-01 实施，全部代替 GB/T 15852.1-2008；它修改采用 ISO/IEC 9797-1:2011，并在后者六种算法基础上增加 TrCBC 与 CBCR，测试向量从 DEA 改为 SM4。这版把“采用分组密码的 MAC”从零散算法收拢为八种可选机制，同时保留 2008 版的用户要求与一般模型，便于国内密码模块和协议实现直接引用。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：GB/T 15852.1-2020 消息鉴别码 第1部分：采用分组密码的机制的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 GB/T 15852.1-2020 消息鉴别码 第1部分：采用分组密码的机制 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

en.principle: **Standard**: Message Authentication Codes—Part 1: Mechanisms Using a Block Cipher (GB/T 15852.1-2020 消息鉴别码 第1部分：采用分组密码的机制). GB/T 15852.1-2020 turns a block-cipher MAC into an eight-step pipeline: optional key induction, message padding, data splitting, initial transform, repeated block-cipher application, final iteration, output transform and truncation. The base CBC-MAC sets H0=0^n, computes Hi=E_K(Pi⊕Hi-1) block by block, and outputs Hm. The other seven algorithms change the start, the end or the truncation rule of this chain to handle arbitrary lengths or reduce key and storage overhead.
en.why:
CBC-MAC is reliable only for fixed-length messages. If arbitrary-length messages are fed in directly, an attacker can extend the chain and forge a valid new message. EMAC adds an independent final encryption, ANSI retail MAC uses an encrypt-decrypt transform with two keys, and CMAC uses K1/K2 for complete and incomplete blocks; each cuts the concatenation attack without adding many block-cipher calls.

The standard places all eight algorithms under one model so implementers can choose by message length, key length, storage and call count, while checking padding, initial transform, final iteration and truncation against one test-vector set.
en.used:
Start with the message space: fixed-length messages can use CBC-MAC; arbitrary lengths favour CMAC, EMAC or TrCBC; MacDES suits a key twice the block-cipher key length; storage-limited settings can use TrCBC/CBCR.

Implement against Annex B step by step: SM4 has a 128-bit block and a 128-bit key; CMAC subkeys are K1=dbl(E_K(0^n)) and K2=dbl(K1); truncation takes only the specified bits and must not be replaced by XOR or a hash.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
A MAC gives integrity and origin authentication, not confidentiality; reusing a key across protocols or directions weakens the boundary. With an m-bit tag the ideal forgery probability is about 2^-m, but a short m is hit faster by birthday bounds and online queries.

Verification must compare in constant time, not short-circuit by byte; CBC-MAC is not for variable-length messages; TrCBC tags are limited to below n/2 and cannot be treated as a general long-tag MAC.
en.history:
GB/T 15852.1-2020 was published on 2020-12-14 and took effect on 2021-07-01, fully replacing GB/T 15852.1-2008. It is a modified adoption of ISO/IEC 9797-1:2011, adds TrCBC and CBCR to the six base algorithms, and changes the test vectors from DEA to SM4.

This edition consolidates block-cipher MACs into eight selectable mechanisms while retaining the 2008 user requirements and general model, so domestic cryptographic modules and protocol implementations can cite it directly.
